commands.review_summary:
The PR adds scheduled Send Later creation via `send-rich --schedule`, scheduled list/cancel CLI commands, scheduled JSON-RPC methods, schedule-row schema detection, docs, skill notes, and tests.

Reproducibility: yes. for the blocking review findings: source inspection shows `--schedule` is accepted before the file branch invokes `.sendAttachment`, and the scheduled GUID resolver matches only chat and timestamp.
commands.review_followup: - Manual review remains appropriate because the PR defines new public scheduled-message CLI/RPC behavior over private IMCore selectors and still has delivery-sensitive code defects.

target.title: feat: add scheduled messages
target.body:
## Summary
- add `send-rich --schedule <iso8601>` for bridge-backed Send Later creation
- add read-only `scheduled list` and bridge-backed `scheduled cancel`
- expose scheduled create/list/cancel/delete over JSON-RPC
- add scheduled row schema detection, status selector reporting, docs, and tests
- fix scheduled create output to resolve the actual scheduled `chat.db` row GUID instead of returning the transient bridge GUID
- filter `scheduled list` to future scheduled rows so delivered Send Later rows do not linger in the pending list
- cancel scheduled messages through IMD's `IMDMessageRecordDeleteMessagesForGUIDs` fallback when chat-level private selectors are unavailable

## Redacted runtime proof on lobster
Proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/163-scheduled-messages`.
Short-delivery proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/163-scheduled-messages/short-delivery-20260708-194319`.
Cancel proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/163-scheduled-messages/cancel-imd-delete-20260708-201311`.
Raw logs stay local because they include chat/message GUIDs and local account identifiers.

Before on upstream `main`:
- `origin/main` did not expose `scheduled` command routing or `scheduledMessages.*` RPC methods.

After on branch `9ae7c790836dc44ae96e27e8b6c47f7740c66bca`:
- `imsg completions llm` exposes `send-rich --schedule`, `scheduled list`, `scheduled cancel MESSAGE-GUID`, and `scheduledMessages.createScheduledMessage/getScheduledMessages/cancelScheduledMessage/deleteScheduledMessage`.
- Branch-local helper was launched with `./bin/imsg launch --dylib "$PWD/bin/imsg-bridge-helper.dylib"`.
- `./bin/imsg status --json` reported `v2_ready=true`, `advanced_features=true`, and selector `scheduledMessage=true`.

Create/list proof:
- Target was the explicit test chat `Lobster Test Group` (chat row 22); identifiers are redacted.
- `./bin/imsg send-rich --chat <redacted-chat-guid> --text 'PR163 scheduled proof fixed <stamp>' --schedule <+1h ISO8601> --json` returned `queued=1`, `scheduleType=2`, `scheduleState=1`, `scheduledAt=<+1h>`.
- `./bin/imsg scheduled list --json` returned the same scheduled row with `chat_id=22`, `schedule_type=2`, `schedule_state=1`, and the same scheduled timestamp.
- The fixed `send-rich --schedule --json` result resolves the real scheduled DB row GUID; redacted compare: `send_guid == list_guid`.

Delivery proof:
- Scheduled two short-window messages in `Lobster Test Group`:
  - `PR163 short delivery +1 20260708-194319`, due `2026-07-08 19:44:19 PDT`
  - `PR163 short delivery +3 20260708-194319`, due `2026-07-08 19:46:19 PDT`
- User visually confirmed both messages arrived in Messages.app.
- `imsg history --chat-id 22 --limit 10 --json` read both delivered rows back with `created_at` exactly matching their scheduled timestamps.
- After delivery, `scheduled list` no longer reports those delivered rows; it only reports future scheduled rows.

Cancel proof:
- Manual native cancel of two future proof rows removed their `message` rows and `chat_message_join` rows entirely; no tombstone rows appeared in `deleted_messages` or `scheduled_messages_pending_cloudkit_delete`.
- Existing `delete-message` / `deleteChatItems:` was tested against a disposable scheduled row and did **not** cancel it; the message later delivered. That path is intentionally not used for scheduled cancel.
- `scheduled cancel` was then wired to `IMDMessageRecordDeleteMessagesForGUIDs` after chat-level scheduled selectors were unavailable.
- Disposable proof row `PR163 cancel via IMD delete <stamp>` was created for +10 minutes. Before cancel, read-only SQL showed a pending row with `schedule_type=2`, `schedule_state=1`. After `./bin/imsg scheduled cancel <guid> --json`, the command returned selector `IMDMessageRecordDeleteMessagesForGUIDs`, direct SQL found no row for the GUID, and `scheduled list` had no match.
- Visual caveat under investigation: Messages.app still showed a dashed Send Later bubble for that canceled GUID before its due time. Final cancel parity requires confirming it does not deliver at the due time and/or finding the UI refresh/native cancel path.

## Verification
- `make build` ✅ on lobster after the latest patch
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked after swift-format by local SwiftLint/SourceKit crash: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before tests execute on this host: SwiftPM cannot import repo-wide `Testing` module (`no such module 'Testing'`)
- GitHub CI pending for `9ae7c79` (cancel visual caveat under investigation)
